notes.text: CONGLOBATED (since 01/01/2009): contingenza and EDR are inglobated into the tabular minimum. Single base_salary column per level; no separate contingenza allowance.
Level Q (Quadro): indennita di funzione +82.63 EUR/month on top of the tabular minimum (all tranches). Modelled as INDENNITA_FUNZIONE fixed allowance, months_per_year=13.

TRANCHES 01/10/2026 through 01/11/2028: L4 reference increments confirmed from primary source (CISL communique CCNL occhialeria 30/01/2026: +30, +50, +45, +20 EUR at L4). All-level amounts derived via the parametric ratio matrix from confirmed 01/03/2026 per-level deltas. The CCNL occhialeria uses a declared parametric system; parametric derivation is contractually consistent.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Art. 24, p. 40 of the CCNL testo definitivo 2023, CNEL deposit 176781, https://azstcnesa0002prodwe001.blob.core.windows.net/archivio-contratti/archivio%2F2023%2Fe5a59528-7634-4026-b087-0c21d247f1c7%2F20175.pdf, sha256 f32ae476b175e22d8b918c7f3e07f5472d91852505dc29e3ab022547f3b139c1, read on the OCR of the scan and on the 2021 text, same page): 'L’intero periodo di apprendistato professionalizzante è utile ai fini della maturazione dell’anzianità aziendale, anche ai fini degli aumenti periodici di anzianità; tali aumenti saranno corrisposti nelle misure previste dal livello/area-step di appartenenza': seniority_increments.apprentice_level_amount.

reviews.scope: The Elemento Retributivo Nazionale (conglobated minimo, TEM) of the ten levels against the signed ipotesi of the 2023-2025 renewal (28 April 2023, ERN table for 1.05.2023, 1.03.2024, 1.02.2025) and of the 2026-2028 renewal (30 January 2026, ERN table for March 2026 to November 2028), both published by FILCTEM-CGIL, a signatory.
findings: The two FILCTEM-CGIL scans (signed by ANFAO, Filctem, Femca, Uiltec) print the ERN per level for every tranche of the file: 2023 ipotesi PDF p. 22, 2026 ipotesi PDF p. 30 (All. 1). Both are image-only scans read on the page images (tesseract garbles the 2026 table). Level codes map one to one (Q, 6, 5S, 5, 4S, 4, 3S, 3, 2, 1); the 2023 table labels them by area and step professionale (e.g. '4° S Qualificata Consolidato').

The ERN is the conglobated tabular minimum and matches the file's base_salary meaning; the Q indennita di funzione is not in the ERN (Q ERN is only a few euro above level 6), consistent with the file's separate allowance.
Level 1 MAG.2027: the 2026 table prints 1.661,71, a transposition of 1.661,17 (1.622,04 + 39,13; 1.661,17 + 35,21 = 1.696,38 printed for MAG.28). The file's 1661.17 is kept as a derived value.

Level 4S 1.03.2024 and 1.02.2025: the 2023 table prints 2.014,69 and 2.074,05, but its own increments give 2.016,18 and 2.075,54, and the 2026 table (2.126,94 - 51,40) implies 2.075,54. The definitive text of 4 December 2023 reportedly corrected some minimi but is not published by a signatory; both periods are left unbacked.

One-cent residuals between the two signed tables remain for levels 6 and 5S (2025 ERN 2.448,66 and 2.323,28 vs 2.448,67 and 2.323,29 implied by the 2026 ERN minus the first 2026 tranche); each period is backed by the table that prints it.

Consistency check (base + printed increment) on both tables: 2023 table off by -0,01 for level 6 at 1.03.2024 (2.319,66 + 58,98 = 2.378,64 vs 2.378,63 printed) and by -1,49 for 4S; 2026 table consistent except the level 1 MAG.2027 transposition. Rule applied: a printed value stays a verified row unless a later signed table contradicts it by more than rounding (4S, unbacked); one-cent residuals are kept as printed and reported here.
The ruleset names a FILCTEM-CGIL document, a signatory: source_type contracting_party.

reviews.scope: Art. 24 apprenticeship of the CCNL of 10 June 2021 (pp. 39-40); the renewal of 30 January 2026 searched for an amendment.
findings: The apprentices are under-classified (two levels, one, then the destination), not paid 100%: the 2026 percentages abrogated are those of the PPVA premium per step.

location.section: Art. 24 - Apprendistato professionalizzante
location.quote: in vigore dall'1.7.2017 [...] durata complessiva / primo / secondo / terzo periodo: 36 10 10 16 [Quadro/6°, 5°S/5°, 4°S/4°, 3°S, 3°]; 24 6 6 12 [2°]. L'inquadramento e il relativo trattamento economico è così determinato: nel primo periodo di apprendistato professionalizzante: due livelli sotto quello di destinazione finale; nel secondo periodo: un livello sotto quello di destinazione finale; nel terzo e ultimo periodo: livello di destinazione finale. Gli apprendisti con destinazione finale al 2°livello/Area Operativa-Centrato saranno inquadrati al livello di destinazione finale con decorrenza dall'inizio del secondo periodo di apprendistato.

provenance.transformation: Each row of the area-step grid is a level (order 1 to 10): two rows below for 10 months, one row below for 10, then the destination for the last 16.

location.section: Art. 54 - Tutela della maternità e congedi parentali
location.quote: si fa riferimento ai divisori fissi contrattuali, pari a: 173 ore/mese per l’orario a 40 ore; 156 ore/mese per l’orario 6x6.

provenance.transformation: The divisor of the 6x6 schedule (six hours a day on six days, a full-time week of 36 hours) is 156, as the CCNL's fixed divisor for 40 hours is 173 (parameters.hourly_divisor). The clause states the two divisors in the article on parental leave, calling them the fixed contractual divisors: read as the hourly divisor of the 36-hour week. Read on the rendered page of the scan.
